key_insight: Reasoning efficiency in LLMs can be improved by swapping the Thinking model’s null-space component while keeping the Non-thinking model’s dominant subspace, preserving accuracy and reducing token cost.
engineering_relevance: The training-free S^3 composition offers a practical way to deploy faster reasoning models with better accuracy–efficiency tradeoffs across dense and MoE systems.
method: Decompose paired Non-thinking and Thinking checkpoints using the Non-thinking model’s dominant singular directions.
Keep the Non-thinking weights in the dominant subspace and replace the Thinking model’s null-space component.
Use the resulting Spectral Null-Space Swap (S^3) as a training-free model composition strategy.
evidence_signal: Across 28 evaluation environments on 2B–30B dense and MoE models, S^3 reduced inference token overhead by 27.4% on average while improving overall accuracy by 1.0 percentage point.
watch_item: The method depends on having paired Non-thinking and Thinking checkpoints and may be sensitive to how the dominant subspace is estimated for a given architecture or task.
paper_title: $S^3$: Spectral Null-Space Swap Makes Reasoning Models Efficient
